headline: Chargers OT Joe Alt Expected To Miss Week 5
summary: The Chargers will have to navigate yet another injury to their offensive line. Days after learning that left tackle Rashawn Slater will be shut down with a high ankle sprain, we’re now learning that right tackle Joe Alt is expected to miss Week 5 with a neck injury, per NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport. headline: Texans' DeMeco Ryans taking over defensive playcalling duties
summary: Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said Wednesday that he will be taking over the defensive playcalling duties amid his team's 0-4 start.

headline: Odell Beckham Jr.: Kevin O'Connell wanted me to be here
summary: Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell and new Vikings receiver Odell Beckham Jr. spent time together with the Rams, and they both have a Super Bowl ring from it.

headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels fully practices, trending toward return
summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels continued on a path that is expected to result in him playing Sunday against the New York Giants, only three weeks after he dislocated his elbow.

headline: Ravens expect Cam Jurgens to be ready to play in Week 6
summary: The Ravens traded for center Cam Jurgens on Wednesday, but it doesn't look like his debut for the team will come for another week.

headline: NFL, union clarify celebration rules, OK drinking gestures
summary: The NFL and NFLPA said recent player celebrations imitating drinking a beverage will no longer be violations or result in discipline. The sides also clarified what celebrations remain prohibited.
